text: Figure 18.6.2: Procedure to find a circuit in a graph. Find a vertex w, that is not an isolated vertex. Select any edge {w, x} incident to w. (Since w is not isolated, there is always at least one such edge.) Current trail T := (w, X) last == x While there is an edge {last, y} that has not been used in T: Addytotheend of T last:=y
